scripts.harness.js: opens a guide through Playwright and exposes internals (BANK, quiz state, pure functions) as window.__T by an in-memory injection; guide files are not modified
scripts.smoke.js: every tab, every control, then 3 x 400 random clicks per tab, at 1280x900 and 390x844 (RM=1 for reduced motion); errors, NaN/undefined/Infinity/null/[object Object], horizontal overflow
scripts.banks.js: every bank item, every generator drawn 2,500 times; structural and key checks; dumps every distinct question with its key to bank-dump-*.txt
scripts.quizui.js: answers 400 questions per practice block through the real UI with the keyed/displayed answer; also wrong-answer and Show-answer paths
scripts.models.js: exhaustive builder logic checks against independent expectations (sugar names/relations, Haworth faces, chairs, disaccharides, fatty acid names/omega/checker, TAG names, lipid assembler, beta oxidation, FAS ledger, lipoproteins, membrane model)
scripts.drawings.js: renders structure galleries (drawings-*.png) and measures bond angles at drawn carbonyl carbons
scripts.targeted.js: follow-up checks of the suspected faults (targeted-results.json, targeted-disaccharide-faces.png)
scripts.overflow390.js: reproduces the 390 px overflow in the fatty acid builder (overflow390-fa.png)
